name: einzel-lens
description: Exact invariant: a static field does no net work, so ACC-4 bounds the drift at 1 ppm and this path crosses a strong field twice. Three coaxial tubes with the centre one at 500 V - the device this platform is named after, and a unipotential lens: an ion enters and leaves at the same energy however strongly the middle electrode focuses it. What is asserted is exactly that, because it is an invariant rather than a number this engine chose: total energy is conserved across a path that crosses a strong field twice. It also converges for either sign of the centre voltage, which is the classic non-obvious property of an einzel lens and the one a merely plausible field fails.
